name: MLB Dodgers runs scored per game (offense), 2024 daily
citation: MLB Dodgers runs scored per game (offense), 2024 daily. Data obtained from Retrosheet 2024 game logs (gl2024.zip), www.retrosheet.org/gamelogs/. The information used here was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by Retrosheet. Interested parties may contact Retrosheet at www.retrosheet.org.

description: Per-game runs scored by the 2024 Los Angeles Dodgers offense, with a covariate panel of same-game offensive box-score counts. Application: run-production forecasting ("how many runs will we score?"). Target = runs scored.
preprocessing: 1. Per-game Dodgers 2024 box-score series extracted from Retrosheet game logs; one value per game.
2. Reshaped to TempusBench long format: one row per variable with columns variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps, values.
3. Games re-indexed to consecutive daily dates; timestamps emitted as ISO-8601 UTC strings (00:00:00Z), shared across all variables.

4. Variable and unit names written in plain English (spaces, no underscores); the target_ prefix dropped. No calendar/time-feature covariates are included — the only notion of time is the shared timestamps list.
5. runs scored (target, runs): Runs scored by the Dodgers (per game)
6. hits (covariate, hits): Hits by the Dodgers (per game)
7. doubles (covariate, doubles): Doubles by the Dodgers (per game)
8. home runs (covariate, home runs): Home runs by the Dodgers (per game)
9. walks (covariate, walks): Walks drawn by the Dodgers (per game)
10. strikeouts (covariate, strikeouts): Strikeouts by Dodgers batters (per game)
11. stolen bases (covariate, stolen bases): Stolen bases by the Dodgers (per game)
12. left on base (covariate, runners): Runners left on base by the Dodgers (per game)
